name: io.github.LetsFG/letsfg
title: LetsFG — Flights & Hotels
description: Search and book flights and hotels: hundreds of airlines, plus pay-later hotel rates.

environmentVariables.name: LETSFG_BEARER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Free PFS Bearer token from `letsfg auth` (zero-amount card setup, nothing charged, 90-day token). Covers flight search and booking. Hotel tools do not accept it — they need LETSFG_API_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: LETSFG_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Developer API key (prepaid credits) from letsfg.co/developers. Required for all hotel tools, and for unlock_flight_offer, resolve_location and get_agent_profile.
